results.title: Iran World Cup 2026 Preview: Odds, Picks, Players to Watch & Predictions
highlights:
Iran World Cup 2026 Preview: Odds, Picks, Players to Watch & Predictions
[...]
Iran have established themselves as World Cup regulars over the past two decades, qualifying for four of the last five tournaments and featuring in each of the last three. Yet despite that consistency, they've never made it past the group stage - a record they will be desperate to put right when they arrive in North America.
[...]
## ✅ What is the best bet for Iran at the World Cup 2026?
[...]
I think Iran are well placed to break new ground by extending their stay at this summer’s World Cup beyond the group stage. I’d expect Amir Ghalenoei’s side to start brightly with a narrow win over New Zealand in their Group G opener. Taking points off Belgium on matchday two may prove a step too far. However, Iran are stubborn opposition who have a knack for staying in games, and if they do so again against Egypt on matchday three, a single point could be enough to take them into the knockout rounds.
[...]
Three points could be enough and considering New Zealand just lost 4-0 to Haiti, Iran are rightfully odds-on favourites heading into that clash.
